models.positioning: ElevenLabs expressive, multilingual high-quality text-to-speech and dialogue synthesis model for narration, audiobooks and character performances.
notes: Provider-native ID eleven_v4 is available through the Text to Dialogue API; supports 90+ languages, including Arabic, and multiple speakers.

ElevenLabs documents one credit per character for text-to-speech as its general usage model; API pricing varies by plan, discounts and usage. We do not claim a verified flat USD-per-character price specific to Eleven v4.
Credits and plans are not convertible to one universal public USD rate. SXF therefore lists the native unit, provider billing reference and no invented flat Standard API rate.
The provider distinguishes Eleven v4 quality-first delivery from v4 Turbo optimized for near-realtime voice agents. The generic text calculator is disabled.

notes: Provider-native ID eleven_v4_turbo is supported by ElevenLabs Text to Dialogue WebSocket and its realtime/agent ecosystem; 90+ languages including Arabic.
ElevenLabs reports approximately 100ms median inference latency for the model; this is a provider-reported figure, not an independent SXF benchmark.

ElevenLabs uses credits tied to input characters and subscriptions, but a universal public USD Standard rate for this specific API model and all plans is not established in the cited source. No invented direct price is supplied.
